read_rule: IJR's schedule: a line holding the title 'iShares S&P SmallCap 600 Index Fund' alone (nothing after 'Fund') within 3 lines of 'Schedule of Investments'; its common stocks the rows (name, shares, value) between 'COMMON STOCKS' and 'TOTAL COMMON STOCKS'; total_ok = every such schedule's summed value equals the filing's own total; a filing with no schedule is a line here, never a guess

x.reads: each period its original filing (the earliest acceptance, when the list is first knowable); each /A compared beside it
x.map_rule: Sharadar SEP tickers (no preferred, no warrant) trading within 31 days of the list date; tiers 1–2 the name in force at the date ± 120 days (namechangefrom history; full words, then EDGAR-conformed abbreviations), 3–4 any name of the ticker, 5 plural-folded, 6 whole-word prefix or space-free equality; several candidates resolve only as one issuer's share classes (the fund's class letter ends the ticker, else the primary class)
